title: Verify Medic Hub v1.2.4 and IBM endpoints
description: Verify the Medic Hub is running the correct version and its IBM QPU endpoints respond.
objectives: Check the Hub /health endpoint and confirm it reports version 1.2.4
Report the Hub's listening address/port and container/process status
If the Hub is not running, report that and stop — do not start it
constraints: Read-only verification; do not modify Hub config or .env
Do not submit any QPU jobs through the Hub
If the Hub is down, report status and stop
